scope: Geometry only; actual corrected track boxes and original images; same fixed crops/masks per variant.
limitations: No manual rotation or silhouette ground truth. Geometry coverage is not accuracy. Historical/new masks can differ because extraction seed and boxes differ. No defect inference or grade.
selection_rule: Baseline IDs [125, 1, 14]: prior numerically graded example plus first two selected records; not random.
